name: pdf-master
description: PDF Master - editor y suite completa de herramientas PDF para Windows y macOS
author: Hugo Antivil <hugo.antivil@pertec.cl>

scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish always
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal --publish never
scripts.release:mac: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal --publish always
scripts.update-engines: npm update pdfjs-dist @cantoo/pdf-lib @cantoo/fontkit tesseract.js docx pptxgenjs exceljs && npm run build:renderer && npm test
